record.question: Identify the Part of Speech of the word 'kindly' in: Kindly help me.
record.explanation: Answer D: Adverb. In the imperative “Kindly help me,” kindly modifies help and is an adverb of manner/politeness. Independent check: “Kindly” modifies the imperative “help” and is an adverb. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/adverbs. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
